purpose: Human-reviewable plan consumed by Scripts/release_import_menorah_v3.py: native OBJ import of the seven original MenorahV3 parts (base, shaft, branches L/R, ornaments, lamps, three-step tending stone), gold on every slot of the six gold parts and a stone material on the step stone, GeometryScript winding check with conditional flip, removal of the CC BY Titus-style RELEASE_Menorah actor (asset stays on disk with its attribution) and placement of the RELEASE_MenorahV3_* assembly at X -5330 with the lamp row north-south and the nearest lamp tip 125 cm from the south wall. Every number below is read from the frozen geometry manifest or earlier receipts; nothing here claims visual acceptance.
lastKnownMapSha256Note: Walkthrough.umap on disk when this spec was prepared (after the dove/resident integration, AGENTS.md main SHA 2edb00af...). Recorded as matched/not matched only, not a guard.
collisionNote: Base and StepStone are BlockAll with importer-generated simple collision (auto_generate_collision True on those two imports; the tending stone is a walkable prop and the plinth must not be walked through). Shaft, branches, ornaments and lamps are NoCollision (thin ornament, not on the visitor route).

source.objAdapter: Source OBJ has Y reflected and triangle winding reversed for the legacy OBJ importer (create_menorah_v3.write_obj, same as the ShulchanV2 / doors / reliefs adapter). The importer reflects Y back, so the imported StaticMesh must reproduce canonicalBoundsCm (local X = lamp row, local +Y = front/stone side) and UE signed volumes must be positive. Every part shares the bottom-centre pivot under the plinth, so all seven actors take the same transform.

importSettings.note: Identical to the reviewed keilim/keruvim/reliefs/doors/vessels/shulchan OBJ adapter path (FbxFactory). Single-mesh OBJ: destination_name is the exact mesh name. auto_generate_collision is overridden to True for the meshes flagged autoGenerateCollision (Base, StepStone).

materials.rule: First candidate that exists on disk and loads as a MaterialInterface is assigned to EVERY slot of the mesh (SM_KeruvimStudyV1 lesson). Falling past the first candidate is recorded as a limitation.

candidates.kind: gold (same as the vessels release / RELEASE_Menorah)

stone.method: Only if no candidate exists: EditorAssetSubsystem.duplicate_asset(duplicateFrom -> createPath) then Constant3Vector/Constant expressions rewired to BaseColor/Metallic/Roughness (shulchan bread recipe); fallback MaterialFactoryNew. Recorded.

constants.note: pale limestone tone; artistic real-time choice

windingCheck.note: GeometryScript readback of the imported LOD0 source model (needs -EnablePlugins=GeometryScripting): bulk vertex/triangle lists, signed volume by the divergence theorem with UE left-handed face normal cross(C-A, B-A), a sample cross-checked against get_triangle_face_normal (disagreements must be 0). Falls back to the per-triangle loop. Negative volume -> triangle order reversed with append_buffers_to_mesh and written back with copy_mesh_to_static_mesh, re-saved, re-checked, recorded.
windingCheck.expectedOfflineRightHandedVolumeSign: positive for all seven files (create_menorah_v3 readback: the Y reflection and the winding reversal each flip the sign once), so no flip is expected; the flip path exists for safety.

removal.note: The CC BY Titus-style RELEASE_Menorah (Dahan Meir, third-party vessels release) is destroyed in memory AFTER the .umap checkpoint and only persists as removed when the level is saved at the end; its label, folder, mesh, pose and world bounds are recorded. The run refuses if it is not found exactly once with this mesh, folder and pose (native-import-vessels-20260907T190204035803Z.json reopenedReadback). The imported asset SM_ThirdParty_Menorah_DahanMeir and its attribution stay on disk untouched.
removal.label: RELEASE_Menorah
removal.assetsLeftInPlace: SM_ThirdParty_Menorah_DahanMeir (CC BY 4.0) stays in /Game/MikdashV3/ThirdParty/Vessels; keep its CREDITS entry while the asset is in Content.

placement.axes: X east; Y south; Z up. Local X = lamp row -> yaw -90 turns local +X into world -Y (north) so the row runs north-south; local +Y (front, stone side) -> world +X (east).
placement.xBasis: kept from the current RELEASE_Menorah (book p. 252: 5 amot from the west wall X -5600; book-keilim-review item 2)
placement.yRule: y = southWallY - nearestTipClearanceCm - halfSpan, where halfSpan = max |local X| over the six menorah parts (imported bounds; manifest half_span_x_cm 59.824 -> y 315.176). Book p. 252 (5): 2.5 amot from the southern wall, measured to the tips as in the vessels release.
placement.baseRule: Actor Z = floor top (925) - local min Z (0): the plinth and the stone stand on the measured Heikhal floor.
placement.stoneRule: The stone actor shares the transform; its world AABB must lie entirely east (greater X) of the plinth AABB and must not touch it.

floor.groundSource: floor component bounds read from the loaded level (traces return nothing in commandlets)

roomEnvelope.rule: Every placed AABB must lie inside the Heikhal envelope.

clearance.rule: Each planned world AABB must not have strictly positive overlap volume with any mesh-bearing actor of the level other than the removed RELEASE_Menorah, the floor, terrain tiles and hollow architecture unions whose verified constituent boxes are not hit (release_place_assets.py rules). A blocker refuses the run BEFORE anything is saved.

verification.compareRule: Numeric location/rotation/scale fields and AABB corners only.

limitations: Original interpretive model guided by the Torah/Talmud counts and the TI photograph's silhouette; not a measured TI replica (menorah-model-spec claims_not_allowed). Lamp pitch, branch section, ornament profiles, plinth and stone sizes are artistic (geometry-manifest dimensions table).
Rambam north-south orientation selected (book 22:23b); the Rashi east-west alternative (22:23a) is not modelled.
Wick nozzles follow Rambam 3:8 (six toward the centre, centre toward the west); no flames, oil or service tools.
BlockAll on the plinth and the stone relies on importer-generated simple collision; walkability of the 16.7 cm steps against the 55 cm step height is not tested here.
Import, material assignment, winding check and placement are geometric only; no visual, lighting or packaged acceptance is established.
The removed CC BY menorah asset stays on disk; Content/Distribution/CREDITS.txt is not edited by this script.
